scope: One current full-view timing attribution, not an optimization comparison. Two non-profiled controls bracket one instrumented run. All three use the same mode-zero QA gate and 480-step endpoint; no production edit or native rebuild.
qa_configuration: Isolated synthetic 15-enemy full-view GL scene, stat cache on, save off, true speed 1, 60Hz fixed combat, uncapped frame rate, VSync off, GPU contact and retained flights enabled. The QA DLL is the accepted later build; the ignored DLL present in the source checkout has a different hash and was not loaded.
event_and_state_checks: All three runs complete 480 native steps and have equal event counts and canonical end state after excluding only RNG seed metadata; actual RNG state is equal. Profiled interval: 3520 fire, 13050 hit, 8430 projectile impact, 96 purchases, zero handoffs. Mean active projectiles 363.86. Full-view screenshot is CFP.png.
probe_calibration: 10,000 begin/end record pairs measured outside the timed window: 0.7013, 0.7275, and 0.7044 microseconds per pair in control, profile, control. This is not a subtraction correction for wrappers, clock reads, cache effects or scheduling. Control drift exceeds the apparent 0.239ms profile penalty; no precise observer overhead is inferred.
gpu_overlap: Root viewport mean reported CPU 2.629ms/GPU 0.469ms; ship viewport CPU 0.790ms/GPU 2.623ms. These timestamps can overlap each other and the 3.827ms frame submission window. None is added to the wall ledger or treated as removable cost.
attribution_limits: The wall ledger partitions adjacent post-draw frames and closes arithmetically; it does not turn gaps into known CPU functions. About 1.050ms after main remains unassigned. Native feedback take includes native encoding, while the enclosing consume span includes row decoding, Dictionary construction, Signal delivery and any uninstrumented subscriber work. Necessary gameplay subscriber work is not independently timed, so the full bridge is not a removable budget. Draw spans include required command construction and submission calls. The synthetic held-health fixture does not test wave handoff or a user save.
next_structural_evidence: A persistent typed presentation route needs to prove which parts of the 1.468ms feedback bridge, 1.626ms presentation-event path, and 2.455ms snapshot/display scopes can actually exit together. These inclusive opportunities are not measured net gains.
